text: I had a weird rash nobody knew what it was. The doctor knew after looking at me for a minute and explained it to me. His English is perfect and he is very friendly. I'm so happy I found him!

My experience at this clinic was great.
Dr Suwit was clear and caring with my appointment and was able to provide me with information almost immediately when I went to seek for his help. He was very reassuring, and made me feel at ease.
I was able to collect my prescription after a few minutes and pay a reasonable price there.

Dr. Suwit is professional, compassionate and efficient.  He helped diagnose, explain and treat my condition and set my mind at ease very quickly.
The clinic’s prices are posted and fair and apply to all patients, regardless of nationality.
Depending on the prescription, the clinic can fill it in-house for a fair price.
He was recommended by two local friends, and his clinic lived up to that recommendation.

Waste of time. Expensive. Clearly did not know how to treat my condition but pretended he did and gave me pills and cream without labels so you didn't know exactly what you were being given. When I went back the second time he should have organised further testing but just sent me away with more creams. Ended up at Bangkok Phuket hospital where they diagnosed and treated correctly. Give this "Dr" a miss.
doctor quite ok but dont buy prescribed medications. they charged 250% more than at the pharmacy next door

I went with my friend who thought she had a wart (we were on vacation in Krabi) and the doctor was available to take a look, no appointment needed. We waited for about an hour. The doctor right away noticed it was a tick and was able to remove it and give antiobiotics to my friend very fast. He was super friendly, we were able to communicate in english with no problem. He was also very nice in calming my friend so she can enjoy the rest of our trip in Thailand. Totally recommend!

Very good service. Went here with a skin rash on my chest that was not healing well. After a consultation I was given creams and antibiotics to cure the problem. The treatment worked and I was all good after my second visit which was just to confirm that it was healing and not anything more serious. Best to get there early so that you can get your name down and be in the queue. Would definitely recommend this dermatologist in future.

He is friendly and knowledgeable, and speaks and understands English well, his staff are also nice and easy to deal with. The price is not too expensive and his hours are convenient. I have seen him many times mainly due to dealing with my eczema, he is the person to see if you have any skin issues.
I went there in 3023 , very good doctor and he is very patient

I went to this skin clinc in Krabi Town to have a mole removed, that I have for as long as I can remember. After speaking to the Doctor who spoke perfect English, he informed me it was wart and after the very relaxed consultation he checked some moles on my back that might be suspect cancerous; all ok. Reasonable price paid to.
author_name: Honour Muay Thai Gym Ao Nang Krabi Thailand

He speaks fluent English and charges reasonable rates for the consultation and medicines.
Excellent service!! The Physician is very kindly and help me to calm down. Also, he understands English and explained everything.
I went there last year and he is a nice doctor and knowledgeable

My first visit was very impressive! I really liked the doctor; she spoke very kindly. I'd been to many other places but nothing had worked. Other doctors said it was a skin allergy, but this doctor said it was psoriasis. She's incredibly skilled and brave enough to say it. I love her so much! I love this doctor the most! 👍👍🫰🫰❤️❤️😊😊 …

text:
The staff are polite and lovely, and the doctor is kind, friendly, and gives excellent advice. The prices are reasonable.
You always have to call and make an appointment in advance because the doctor has many regular patients.

Thank you so much, doctor. I'd been to many places to get treatment for my wound without success. I finally decided to go to your clinic. My first visit was perfect; the wound started to improve. You gave me an injection, oral medication, and topical cream. Regarding the price, it wasn't expensive at all. Other clinics charged over a thousand baht; this was only 30 baht more. Thank you so much, doctor.
Before starting treatment, I recommend having 1000 baht, as this might not be enough to cover the treatment and medication costs.

The doctor is kind and made a very thorough diagnosis.
He/She provided excellent advice and encouragement. The price is reasonable and affordable. This is my first time seeing this doctor, and I was very impressed, having visited many other doctors before.
The nurses at the clinic were also very attentive and helpful.

This is the first clinic I want to review. The doctor is very kind and friendly, and the staff are welcoming. The treatment prices are reasonable, not expensive at all considering the quality of treatment and service. Overall, it's excellent. I highly recommend it, especially for dermatology.

It was a very impressive treatment. When I went, I had a rash and itching. I didn't even dare to show my legs to the doctor. I was so depressed.
I saw the doctor and received ointment, injections, and oral medication. After three days, everything has improved dramatically.
When I went to see the doctor, I followed reviews. Today, I'm back with a review. It's very good.

I went to see Dr. Suwit for a problem with bumps between my toes.
The doctor was very competent and immediately diagnosed the condition, which was eczema caused by stress, heat, and humidity.
We left with our medication.
The fee was very reasonable.
The reception was excellent.
The doctor speaks perfect English, and we were able to discuss the problem.
I highly recommend this excellent doctor.

My skin disease has never been cured anywhere else. I've been to clinics all over Krabi and Surat Thani, but this is the only place that has cured it. The topical medication shows results within a day or two, and the internal medication is also very effective. I can guarantee that this place is truly good for skin diseases.
author_name: ปรเมษฐ์ ทวีศรี

text: I highly recommend this doctor to anyone suffering from any kind of skin allergy, experiencing itching for months that didn't improve with treatment in Australia. Upon returning to Thailand, Dr. Suwit gave me two injections and prescribed topical medication, and my skin cleared up completely.

We came as a passerby and asked the staff how many more people were in line so we could plan our travel time correctly. But they answered in an irritated tone and with a frown on their faces, saying, "If you want to find someone, just write your name." We asked again if there was a line. They said, "If you want to find someone, just write your name." Their tone was very unfriendly. So we won't go looking.
Good service. Recommended for skin diseases. I had shingles and the doctor gave good advice and prescribed medication; I recovered in less than a month.
The doctor was very nice and communicative. The clinic was clean and convenient.
